title: COPY --link to a relative destination path breaks layer caching
body:
### Issue Description

When copying files into the image filesystem with `COPY --link` using a relative destination path (e.g. `./`), layer caching breaks for the current and all following instructions.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

1. Use the following `Containerfile` (any file will do, this is just to help reproduce it quickly):
   ```Containerfile
   FROM alpine:latest AS src
   RUN touch /file

   FROM alpine:latest AS absolute
   COPY --link --from=src /file /
   RUN pwd

   FROM alpine:latest AS relative
   COPY --link --from=src /file ./
   RUN pwd
   ```
2. Build the `absolute` target:
   ```text
   › podman build --target absolute .
   [1/2] STEP 1/2: FROM alpine:latest AS src
   [1/2] STEP 2/2: RUN touch /file
   --> f7c29bbb868d
   [2/2] STEP 1/3: FROM alpine:latest AS absolute
   [2/2] STEP 2/3: COPY --link --from=src /file /
   --> c7bdfd05dc58
   [2/2] STEP 3/3: RUN pwd 
   /
   [2/2] COMMIT
   --> 684403893c79
   684403893c79070f31593780c6a4385566d9105bab43167688f57b39d6ad7a55
   ``` 
3. Build the `absolute` target again, confirm all layers are cached:
   ```text
   › podman build --target absolute .
   [1/2] STEP 1/2: FROM alpine:latest AS src
   [1/2] STEP 2/2: RUN touch /file
   --> Using cache f7c29bbb868d5037e8c95c1364042c95190cba3a087ae0958a67e3f10e62bcf6
   --> f7c29bbb868d
   [2/2] STEP 1/3: FROM alpine:latest AS absolute
   [2/2] STEP 2/3: COPY --link --from=src /file /
   --> Using cache c7bdfd05dc581d1e21031ba0bbaddf13fa8c03bc0f9c9d0aa3a9937f489e0b4e
   --> c7bdfd05dc58
   [2/2] STEP 3/3: RUN pwd
   --> Using cache 684403893c79070f31593780c6a4385566d9105bab43167688f57b39d6ad7a55
   --> 684403893c79
   684403893c79070f31593780c6a4385566d9105bab43167688f57b39d6ad7a55
   ```
4. Build the `relative` target:
   ```text
   › podman build --target relative .
   [1/3] STEP 1/2: FROM alpine:latest AS src
   [1/3] STEP 2/2: RUN touch /file
   --> Using cache 63879315c45b9f32a0bff1edd3579d2653f98dfac11c3f8fdc5ca1c7b9c575c3
   --> 63879315c45b
   [3/3] STEP 1/3: FROM alpine:latest AS relative
   [3/3] STEP 2/3: COPY --link --from=src /file ./
   --> c8e8a4049768
   [3/3] STEP 3/3: RUN pwd
   /
   [3/3] COMMIT
   --> a825d8f3889f
   a825d8f3889f9d865190de481cd7179e6057d16198ea01c377de1d08c1637c93
   ```
5. Build the `relative` target again, notice how none of its instructions are cached and they're all run again:
   ```text
   › podman build --target relative .
   [1/3] STEP 1/2: FROM alpine:latest AS src
   [1/3] STEP 2/2: RUN touch /file
   --> Using cache 63879315c45b9f32a0bff1edd3579d2653f98dfac11c3f8fdc5ca1c7b9c575c3
   --> 63879315c45b
   [3/3] STEP 1/3: FROM alpine:latest AS relative
   [3/3] STEP 2/3: COPY --link --from=src /file ./
   --> 72e646bba520
   [3/3] STEP 3/3: RUN pwd
   /
   [3/3] COMMIT
   --> 5307046364a7
   5307046364a71f55536d49bb7237959d10d35ce328a31cf63ac75f980ee35388
   ```

### Describe the results you received

No layer caching, severely degrading the experience when building large images with `podman build`. 

### Describe the results you expected

Expected layer caching to work when using relative destination paths, enabling very commonly used containerfiles like:

```Containerfile
FROM alpine:latest
WORKDIR /app
COPY --link files/ ./
RUN some-build-command .
```
